name: 雾凇拼音 (rime-ice)
description: 一套开箱即用的现代 Rime 配置，内置超大词库、中英混输与多种拼音方案，适合直接替换默认配置。
description_en: A ready-to-use modern Rime preset with a massive dictionary, mixed Chinese/English input, and many pinyin variants.
author: iDvel

name: 万象语法模型 (wanxiang grammar)
description: 本地语言模型（约 200MB），叠加在雾凇拼音之上，显著提升长句联想与整句准确度。只放一个 .gram 文件并启用一行配置，不影响你现有的词库。
description_en: A local grammar model (~200MB) layered on top of Rime Ice to improve long-sentence prediction. Drops in a single .gram file plus one config line; your dictionaries stay untouched.
author: amzxyz
